title: Record phase f lookandfeel verification
description:
Write docs/verification/phase_f_lookandfeel.md documenting phase F verification for CustomLookAndFeel only. Record commands run, exit outcomes, and file scope.

Required verification stack (do not use make):
1) cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja
2) cmake --build cmake-build-debug --target AuralMaximizerPro_Standalone
3) cppcheck --enable=all Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp
4) clang-format --dry-run --Werror Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp

Document palette hex checklist (Background #121417, Panel #1A1D22, Border #2C3038, Maximizer #00D2FF, Exciter #FF9500, Master #34C759, Text #F2F2F7), that drawRotarySlider/ComboBox/ToggleButton are implemented, and that the phase touched only the two LookAndFeel sources plus this verification artifact. Do not implement product code in this task.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.cpp
- docs/verification/ for prior phase verification markdown format if present
